messages:
maria.p: Quick heads-up — I'll be in Split, Croatia for 3 weeks (2026-06-10 to 2026-06-30). Planning to work remotely full-time. Questions: 1) WFH stipend proration? 2) Can I ship my company monitor there? 3) Any tax/payroll or benefits impacts I should flag?

oliver.peopleops: Thanks — dates noted. For the stipend we prorate monthly by calendar days. For a 3-week stint we usually do (days on remote / days in month) * monthly allowance. You can choose cash or reimbursement for shipping. Please submit the Temporary Remote Work Request form so we have it on file: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/forms/temp-remote 

maria.p: I'll submit now. Prefer reimbursement for shipping + a short-term SIM.

sam.tax: Quick tax note: 3 weeks is typically below residency thresholds, but there are two things to watch for — social security rules and whether any client-facing activity happens while you're there. Croatia doesn't automatically create payroll obligations for short personal trips, but if you meet with customers or contractors it can raise flags. Since you said "no client meetings" it's low risk; still, keep travel logs and submit the form. If anything changes I need to know immediately.

jess.teamlead: Approved from my side. Please update your calendar with local time availability. We might need to shuffle on-call.

leo.ops: I can swap on-call week of Jun 14–21 with you. Ping me to confirm.

people-ops-bot: Payroll/Benefits notified: temp_location=Croatia start_date=2026-06-10 end_date=2026-06-30 submitted_by=maria.p request_id=TR-2026-0721

maria.p: Form submitted and IT shipping request opened for a single monitor + short-term SIM. I added a note: strictly personal travel, no client meetings.

sam.tax: Thanks — one final ask: after you return, confirm that no local work contracts/invoices were executed while abroad. If any expenses look like local contractor fees, we will need to review.

oliver.peopleops: We'll calculate prorated stipend in next payroll run once payroll confirms shipping reimbursement.

people-ops-bot: Payroll processed: stipend_prorated=YES amount=€75 reimbursement_for_shipping=YES payroll_batch=2026-06-30 processed_for=maria.p

maria.p: Confirmed receipt of reimbursement. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
